_readme: 默认 24 条微信专辑条目模板。整套可替换：改 text/name/meaning 不影响画面；改 frames/prop_spec 需重新生成对应 sprite sheet。frames 必须是正好 6 条英文姿态名词，C4 为峰值、C6 接回 C1；禁用前倾/后仰/转身背对等深度方向姿态。composition: full|half|scene；motion: dramatic|state。

entries.name: 我看看
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — a BRASS-GOLD MAGNIFYING GLASS: thick round metal ring, clear pale-blue lens with one diagonal highlight streak, short dark-wood handle with a metal ferrule. Ring about one third of the face width. Warm gold and dark brown only, NO silver-gray. Same size, color and shape in all six frames.
entries.face: One eye wide and round behind the lens, the other squinting, one eyebrow raised, mouth slightly open; frame 4 is the roundest eye and most open mouth.
frames: NARROW UPRIGHT, HOLDING LOW: torso straight, both hands hold the magnifier at chest height, head level, arms close to the body.
LIFT AND LEAN IN: both arms rise toward the face, shoulders hunch up, magnifier rising — shorter, wider silhouette.
ONE-EYE PRESS, ASYMMETRICAL: right arm fully extended pressing the lens to the right eye, left hand steadying the rim, head tilted right, left shoulder lifted high.
PEAK — DEEP PEER: lens pressed tightest, shoulder locked at its highest, one arm stretched wide, head at its greatest tilt — the longest reach of all six frames.
LOWER AND STRAIGHTEN: lens dropping to chin level, head returning to center, shoulders lowering, arm span narrowing.
NARROW UPRIGHT AGAIN: both hands holding the magnifier at chest height, matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 发你了
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — a REAL DOCUMENT FOLDER: deep navy-blue (or warm tan leather) cover with a visible FOLDED SPINE along the left edge, a warm metal SPRING CLIP at the top, a small rectangular LABEL STICKER on the front, and the corner of a lined paper sheet peeking out. Warm saturated colors only, NO pure white or neutral gray. It must read as a FILE FOLDER, not a book or a blank rectangle.
entries.face: Eyes looking straight ahead, mouth smiling, head nodding; frame 4 has the most curved smiling eyes and the deepest nod.
frames: NARROW TALL STANDING: folder hugged to the chest with both hands, feet together, fully upright.
SIDE STEP: right foot steps out to the side, both arms begin extending, folder moving out — diagonal silhouette.
DEEP LUNGE OFFER: front knee bent, weight on the front foot, both arms pushing the folder toward the viewer, head nodding down.
PEAK — FULL REACH: arms straight at maximum reach, head bowed lowest, back leg stretched behind — the longest horizontal silhouette of all six frames.
HALF RETREAT: stepping back halfway, elbows folding, torso rising, folder pulling in.
TALL STANDING AGAIN: folder hugged to the chest, matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
entries.recognition: 前踏一步朝观者递出文件夹并点头

entries.name: 稍等一下
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — NO PROPS AT ALL. The hands and body alone must carry the meaning; do not add any object, symbol, star or sweat drop.
entries.face: Eyes calm and unblinking, eyebrows level, mouth pressed into a flat line, never smiling; frame 4 keeps the eyes widest and most still.
frames: ARMS DOWN: both hands at the sides, torso upright, shoulders level.
ONE ARM RISING: right forearm lifts to chest height, palm still a loose fist, shoulder lifting high.
PALM OPENING, SIDE LEAN: right hand opens with fingers spreading, palm turning to face the viewer, torso leaning to one side, head tilting.

PEAK — MAXIMUM OPEN HAND: palm fully facing the viewer, FIVE fingers splayed as wide as possible with visible gaps, left palm held underneath as a stop gesture, right shoulder raised, head tilted — the widest hand silhouette.
SMALL WOBBLE: palm sways once, fingers curling slightly, shoulder lowering, one blink.
ARMS DOWN AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
entries.recognition: 五指张开的掌心正对观者

entries.name: 马上处理
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — an OPEN LAPTOP: deep blue-gray lid with a warm tint (NOT neutral gray), a bright blue SCREEN with 3-4 short white code-line bars, dark charcoal keyboard keys in visible rows; beside it a warm terracotta-orange ceramic MUG with a clear C-SHAPED HANDLE, a dark coffee surface and three curly steam wisps; the desk surface is warm wood brown, never white. Both props stay in the same place, size and colors in all six frames.
entries.face: Eyebrows lowered, pupils shifted down toward the screen, eyes slightly narrowed, mouth pressed tight; frame 4 is the most focused, frame 1 neutral.
frames: HANDS HOVERING: both hands suspended just above the keyboard, shoulders level, head level, screen dim.
HANDS DOWN, HEAD BOWED: both hands land on the keys, head drops, shoulders tighten, screen lights up.
ALTERNATING HANDS: left hand lifted high, right hand pressed down, one shoulder higher — clearly asymmetrical silhouette.
PEAK — FASTEST TYPING: maximum height difference between the two hands, head at its lowest, elbows widest, screen brightest, steam highest — the most compressed and diagonally stretched pose.
HANDS SLOWING: hands settling flat, head lifting a little, shoulders loosening.
HANDS HOVERING AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
entries.recognition: 双手在键盘上快速交替打字、屏幕亮起

entries.name: 辛苦了
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — a warm terracotta-orange ceramic MUG with a cream (NOT pure white) rim band, a clear C-SHAPED HANDLE, a dark coffee surface and three curly steam wisps. Same mug, same size, same handle orientation in all six frames; only the hands carry it forward.
entries.face: Eyes softly half-lowered, mouth smiling gently, head bowing; frame 4 has the lowest, most closed eyes and the deepest bow.
frames: TALL STANDING: both hands cradling the mug at belly height, feet together, fully upright.
MUG LIFT: mug rising to chest height, shoulders softening, steam curling up.
DEEP SIDE LEAN: torso folded sideways about 25 degrees, head down, arms extending with the mug — shorter, wider silhouette.
PEAK — DEEPEST BOW: mug pushed furthest toward the viewer, head at its lowest, knees slightly bent, steam thickest — the widest horizontal silhouette.
RISING HALFWAY: torso unfolding, mug drawing back, head lifting.
TALL STANDING AGAIN: mug back at belly height, matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 确认一下
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — NO PROPS AT ALL. The hands and face alone carry the meaning.
entries.face: One eye slightly narrowed, pupils shifting sideways as if thinking, one eyebrow higher, mouth pursed into a thoughtful hm; frame 4 has the highest eyebrow and strongest sideways glance.
frames: ARMS DOWN, HEAD LEVEL: upright torso, shoulders even, both hands at the sides.
ELBOW PROPPED: right elbow plants on the back of the left hand, right forearm rising, head beginning to tilt, one shoulder lifting.
INDEX FINGER TO CHIN: right index finger touches the chin, head tilted to one side, shoulders uneven, torso leaning sideways.
PEAK — FULL CHIN REST: deepest head tilt, index finger pressed flat against the cheek, elbow firmly planted, torso at its most sideways lean — the most asymmetrical silhouette.
FINGER LIFTING: fingertip leaving the chin, head straightening, shoulders evening out.
ARMS DOWN AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 问一问
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — two objects, BOTH fixed in the same positions in all six frames. (A) a dark charcoal SMARTPHONE with a bright blue screen and one rounded chat bubble on the display. (B) a small desktop ROBOT: a warm-cream (NOT pure white) round head, a dark face panel with a simple smile, ONE antenna topped by a glowing ball, two short stubby arms, a small rounded body. The antenna ball glows brighter only in frame 4.
entries.face: Pupils turning toward the robot, eyes widening, mouth opening into a round O as if asking; frame 4 has the roundest O and widest eyes, frame 1 has pupils lowered to the phone.
frames: HEAD DOWN AT PHONE: shoulders narrow, chin tucked, both hands low holding the phone, robot still and dark.
HEAD UP TURNING: head lifts and turns toward the robot, right hand rising, shoulders twisting.
OPEN PALM TO ROBOT: right palm spread toward the robot, one shoulder raised high, chin lifted — wider silhouette.
PEAK — FULL QUESTION: right arm extended furthest toward the robot, palm widest open, head at its greatest tilt, antenna ball glowing — the widest reach of all six frames.
HAND RETRACTING: arm folding back, head turning back, glow fading.
HEAD DOWN AT PHONE AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
entries.recognition: 对着小机器人举手发问

entries.name: 委屈
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — ONE small warm-cream tissue with a pressed border pattern (NOT pure white), appearing ONLY in frames 4 and 5. In all other frames there is NO object. Do not add any other prop.
entries.face: Eyebrows drooping into an inverted V, eyes brimming with watery highlights, mouth turned down, blush deepening; one tear slides down in frame 4, which also has the most tightly shut eyes.
frames: QUIET SLOUCH: shoulders drooping, head tilted slightly, eyes lowered, both hands down.
EYE RUB: one hand rises to rub an eye, shoulder lifting, mouth pressing flat.
LIP QUIVER: both hands clasp at the chest, shoulders hunching, eyebrows drawing together.
PEAK — TEAR AND TISSUE: one tear visible, the warm-cream tissue appears in one hand, shoulders at their highest, eyes tightest shut — the strongest state.
SNIFFLE: tissue still present, head lifting slightly, one eye half opening.
QUIET SLOUCH AGAIN: matching frame 1, tissue gone, so the loop closes.

entries.name: 我想想
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — NO PROPS AT ALL. The hand and face alone carry the meaning.
entries.face: Eyes glancing upward and sideways, one eyebrow raised, mouth a small flat line; frame 4 has the widest upward glance.
frames: ARMS DOWN: both hands at the sides, head level, shoulders even.
HAND TO TEMPLE: one hand rises to the side of the head, elbow out, head tilting.
SCRATCH BEGIN: fingers touch the head, shoulder lifting, torso leaning sideways.
PEAK — FULL HEAD SCRATCH: hand on top of the head, elbow at its widest, deepest head tilt, other arm spread slightly — the widest asymmetrical silhouette.
HAND LOWERING: fingers leaving the head, head straightening, shoulder dropping.
ARMS DOWN AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 笑不活了
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — NO PROPS AT ALL. The whole body must carry the laughter.
entries.face: Eyes squeezed into curved crescents, mouth wide open laughing; frame 4 has the widest open mouth and the most tightly shut eyes.
frames: NARROW TALL STANDING: upright, feet together, arms at the sides, mouth just starting to smile.
HUNCHED SHOULDER GIGGLE: shoulders lifting high, torso compressing, head tipping to one side, hands coming to the belly.
BENT DOUBLE AT WAIST: torso folding sideways and down, knees beginning to bend, one arm across the belly — much shorter and wider silhouette.
PEAK — THROWN BACK, ARMS FLUNG WIDE, ONE LEG KICKED UP: the most extreme silhouette of all six frames, arms wide open, one foot clearly off the ground.
DEEP SQUAT INTO A BALL: crouched low, arms wrapped around the knees, head down — the shortest silhouette.
STANDING TALL WIPING A TEAR: one hand at the eye, upright again, matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
entries.recognition: 前仰后合、抬腿张臂大笑

entries.name: 比心
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — NO PROPS AT ALL and NO drawn heart symbol. The heart is made ONLY by the fingers.
entries.face: Eyes softening into warm crescents, mouth smiling; frame 4 has the brightest eyes and widest smile.
entries.extra_guard: HEART GESTURE LOCK — ALL SIX FRAMES SHOW THE SAME SINGLE POSE: both hands forming ONE small heart in front of the chest, made ONLY by the fingers with a clear notch at the top and a point at the bottom. The gesture NEVER changes shape, size or position, and the arms NEVER rise above the chest. The ONLY animation is the facial expression plus a tiny 3-5px breathing rise of the shoulders. NEVER slide, scale, bounce or rotate the whole picture. FORBIDDEN: six different body poses, arms over the head, a floating heart, sparkle, glow, star or symbol.
frames: HEART HELD, CALM SMILE: both hands form the small heart at chest height, shoulders relaxed.
HEART HELD, EYES BRIGHTENING: same hand shape and position, cheeks lifting, tiny shoulder rise.
HEART HELD, ONE WINK: same hand shape, one eye closing, head tilting a few pixels.
PEAK — HEART HELD, BIGGEST SMILE: same hand shape, brightest eyes, widest smile, shoulders at their highest — the strongest state.
HEART HELD, SOFT BLINK: same hand shape, eyes half closing, shoulders easing down.
HEART HELD, CALM SMILE AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 捂脸
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — NO PROPS AT ALL.
entries.face: Eyes half closed behind the hands, eyebrows drooping, mouth a small flat line; frame 4 has the most tightly shut eyes.
frames: HANDS LOW: both hands at chest height, shoulders slightly slumped, eyes half lowered.
HANDS RISING: both palms lift toward the face, elbows widening, head tipping down.
PALMS NEAR FACE: both hands close to the cheeks, fingers spread, shoulders hunching.
PEAK — FULL FACE PALM: both palms cover the face, elbows at their widest, head at its lowest, shoulders highest — the strongest state.
FINGERS PARTING: hands lowering a little, one eye peeking through a gap.
HANDS LOW AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 回个电话
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — a deep NAVY-BLUE rounded smartphone with a WARM ORANGE lit screen showing only abstract color blocks and a few short abstract bars: NO text, NO digits, NO caller name, NO letters, NO icons. Held in the RIGHT hand in ALL SIX frames. Same shape, size and colors in every frame. NO pure white or neutral gray parts.
entries.face: Eyes attentive, eyebrows slightly raised, mouth in a small talking shape; frame 4 has the widest eyes and the deepest nod.
frames: PHONE AT SIDE: phone lit at hip height in the right hand, upright stance, feet together.
LIFT AND SIDE STEP: right arm rises, left foot steps out, head tilting toward the phone — wider stance.
PHONE APPROACHING EAR: elbow bending high, shoulder lifting, torso leaning sideways, left arm beginning to open.
PEAK — PHONE AT EAR, OTHER ARM FULLY EXTENDED SIDEWAYS, WIDE SIDE LUNGE: the longest horizontal silhouette of all six frames, head nodding.
ARM LOWERING: phone leaving the ear, extended arm folding back, stance narrowing.
PHONE AT SIDE AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
entries.recognition: 右手手机贴耳、另一臂侧展点头

entries.name: 加油
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — NO PROPS AT ALL. Do not add a flag, banner, star, sparkle or text.
entries.face: Eyes bright and wide, eyebrows lifted, mouth open in an encouraging shout; frame 4 has the widest eyes and most open mouth.
frames: ARMS DOWN: upright stance, feet together, both fists at the sides.
FISTS RISING: both forearms lift, elbows bending, shoulders rising, one knee bending.
ONE ARM UP: right fist punches up, left fist at the chest, torso leaning sideways, stance widening.
PEAK — BOTH ARMS UP IN A WIDE V, ONE KNEE LIFTED HIGH: the tallest and widest silhouette of all six frames.
ARMS LOWERING: fists coming down, knee lowering, shoulders easing.
ARMS DOWN AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
entries.recognition: 双臂高举握拳、抬膝打气

entries.name: 一起喝杯
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — TWO small drinking glasses with warm AMBER liquid, thick glass rims and visible highlights. Warm amber and deep brown only, NO pure white or neutral gray. Both glasses present in ALL SIX frames, one in each hand, same size and color.
entries.face: Eyes warm and half curved, mouth smiling; frame 4 has the widest smile and most curved eyes.
frames: GLASSES APART: both hands low and wide, glasses held apart at chest height, shoulders level.
GLASSES LIFTING: both forearms rise, elbows widening, head tilting slightly.
GLASSES CLOSING IN: hands moving toward each other, shoulders lifting, torso leaning sideways.
PEAK — GLASSES MEETING AT CENTER, ELBOWS WIDEST, BIG SMILE: the most compact center with the widest elbow span.
GLASSES PARTING: hands drawing apart, shoulders lowering, head straightening.
GLASSES APART AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 偷个懒
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — a warm WALNUT-BROWN wooden armchair with visible armrests, a deep BLUE cushion, one warm-TERRACOTTA pillow and a small warm-orange MUG on the armrest. All four props present in ALL SIX frames at the SAME position, size and color. NO pure white or neutral gray parts. This is a FRONT-VIEW SEATED pose in a chair, distinct from a lying-wide-scene sticker.
entries.face: Eyes lazily half closed, mouth a small content line; frame 4 has the most closed eyes and the deepest relaxed slump.
frames: SITTING UPRIGHT: back straight against the chair, both hands on the armrests, eyes half open.
SHOULDERS DROPPING: shoulders sinking, head tipping to one side, one hand lifting the mug slightly.
SLUMP AND STRETCH: torso sliding down, one arm draping over the armrest, head tilting further.
PEAK — DEEPEST SLUMP, EYES CLOSED, FEET STRETCHED OUT: the lowest and widest relaxed silhouette.
SLOW RETURN: shoulders lifting a little, one eye half opening, mug settling back.
SITTING UPRIGHT AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
entries.recognition: 窝在扶手椅里放松瘫坐

entries.name: 假期模式
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — exactly FOUR props, all present in ALL SIX frames at fixed positions and colors: (1) a large umbrella CANOPY ARC with WARM ORANGE and DEEP BLUE stripes, NO white stripes; (2) a FULLY RECLINED flat chaise longue in warm TEAK brown with a striped fabric surface; (3) a warm ORANGE towel; (4) a dark CHARCOAL phone. NO pure white or neutral gray parts. NO sea, NO sky, NO horizon, NO ground plane, NO full background rectangle, NO shadow — everything around the four props stays PURE FLAT WHITE.
entries.face: Eyes closed or dreamily half closed, mouth a soft smile; frame 5 has the most relaxed, fully closed eyes.
entries.extra_guard: WIDE SCENE LOCK — FINAL REMINDER. The body is a LONG HORIZONTAL LINE: head at the LEFT end, both feet at the RIGHT end, spine parallel to the cell bottom edge. The character is LYING DOWN on a FULLY FLAT reclined lounger, with the head TURNED toward the viewer so the face stays visible. ABSOLUTELY FORBIDDEN: a front-facing standing character, a sitting character, an upright chair backrest, a vertical torso, or six near-identical seated portraits. The umbrella canopy arc is large and clearly visible at the top. All FOUR props are present in ALL SIX frames and never change size, color or count. Both feet and both hands fully inside the cell.
frames: LYING FLAT, EYES OPEN: body horizontal on the flat lounger, one hand holding the phone above the chest.
PHONE LOWERING A LITTLE, EYES SOFTENING: same horizontal pose, forearm dropping a few pixels.
TOWEL TUCK: free hand adjusts the orange towel at the side, head rolling slightly toward the viewer.
ARM STRETCH: one arm extends along the lounger, phone still in the other hand, shoulders shifting — the widest horizontal silhouette.
PEAK OF RELAXATION: eyes fully closed, both arms settling, one foot tilting up slightly, deepest settled slump.
LYING FLAT, EYES OPEN AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
entries.recognition: 斜侧远景平躺在遮阳伞下的躺椅上

entries.name: 明天再说
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — a small desk CALENDAR with a dark WALNUT-BROWN base, TWO visible metal RINGS, and ONE single paper page. The page is a perfectly FLAT CLEAN BLANK COLOR BLOCK with NO writing: frames 1, 2 and 6 show a WARM-ORANGE page; frames 4 and 5 show a PALE-CYAN page; frame 3 shows that same page lifted about 45 degrees mid-flip. Precise text is added LOCALLY with a font AFTER generation, so NEVER write anything on the page. The calendar body, base, rings and page count are IDENTICAL in all six frames at the SAME fixed position.
entries.face: Eyes glancing sideways with a mildly guilty look, mouth a small flat line; frame 4 has the widest sideways glance.
entries.extra_guard: CALENDAR CONTINUITY — The calendar NEVER turns into a different object and the page NEVER disappears. FRAMES 1 AND 6 MUST SHOW THE SAME warm-orange page so the loop closes. Keep the page surface a clean blank color block.
frames: BLANK ORANGE PAGE, HANDS STILL: calendar held at chest height, both hands steady, eyes neutral.
FINGER TO PAGE: one index finger rises toward the page edge, shoulder lifting slightly.
PAGE LIFTED MID-FLIP: the single page tilts about 45 degrees, free hand raised — the tallest hand silhouette.
PEAK — FRESH CYAN PAGE, INDEX FINGER POINTING AT IT: arm at its furthest reach, head tilting, widest sideways glance.
FINGER HOLDING, CYAN PAGE: finger still pointing, shoulders easing a little.
BACK TO BLANK ORANGE PAGE, HANDS STILL: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
entries.recognition: 翻一页台历并指一下，循环回到今天

entries.name: 抱抱
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — NO PROPS AT ALL. Do not add a heart, star or sparkle.
entries.face: Eyes softly closing, eyebrows relaxed, mouth a gentle smile; frame 4 has the most closed eyes and warmest smile.
frames: ARMS DOWN: upright stance, feet together, both arms at the sides.
ARMS OPENING: both arms swing outward, elbows bending, shoulders lifting, head tilting.
WIDE REACH: both arms spread wide at chest height, stance widening, torso leaning sideways.
PEAK — ARMS FULLY WRAPPED INWARD INTO A HUG, HEAD TUCKED, KNEES SOFT: the widest and roundest silhouette of all six frames.
ARMS RELAXING: arms unfolding, shoulders lowering, head lifting.
ARMS DOWN AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 送你小花
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — ONE small flower with FIVE warm CORAL-PINK rounded petals, a GOLDEN-YELLOW center and a short DEEP-GREEN stem with two small leaves. Same flower, same size, same colors in ALL SIX frames. NO pure white or neutral gray parts. Do not add extra flowers, sparkles or a bouquet.
entries.face: Eyes bright and friendly, mouth smiling; frame 4 has the widest smile and most curved eyes.
frames: FLOWER LOW: flower held at chest height, arms close to the body, shoulders level.
FLOWER LIFTING: forearm rises, elbow widening, head tilting slightly.
ONE-STEP OFFER: flower arm extending toward the viewer, other hand opening, shoulder lifted high.
PEAK — FLOWER EXTENDED FURTHEST, OTHER ARM OPEN WIDE, DEEPEST HEAD TILT: the longest reach of all six frames.
DRAWING BACK: flower arm folding back, shoulders lowering, head straightening.
FLOWER LOW AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 你真棒
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — NO PROPS AT ALL. No star, sparkle, trophy or text.
entries.face: Eyes bright and wide, eyebrows lifted, mouth in a wide smile; frame 4 has the brightest eyes and widest smile.
entries.extra_guard: THUMBS-UP LOCK — One hand holds ONE clear thumbs-up gesture in front of the chest in ALL SIX frames: a single upright thumb plus a closed fist outline, with visible finger separation. The gesture keeps the same size and position; only the face, a tiny shoulder rise and a small nod animate. NEVER slide, scale or rotate the whole picture. FORBIDDEN: an open five-finger palm, two thumbs, a drawn symbol, or six different body poses.
frames: THUMB UP, CALM SMILE: hand at chest height, shoulders relaxed, eyes open.
THUMB UP, EYES BRIGHTEN: same gesture, eyebrows lifting, tiny shoulder rise.
THUMB UP, SMALL NOD: same gesture, head tipping a few pixels, one eye winking.
PEAK — THUMB UP, BIGGEST SMILE, DEEPEST NOD: same gesture, brightest eyes, shoulders at their highest.
THUMB UP, SOFT BLINK: same gesture, eyes half closing, shoulders easing.
THUMB UP, CALM SMILE AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 干饭啦
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — a deep TERRA-COTTA ORANGE bowl with a cream (NOT pure white) rim band, filled with warm BEIGE rice and a few warm-brown toppings, plus a pair of DARK WALNUT chopsticks. Both the bowl and the chopsticks are present in ALL SIX frames at the same size and color. NO pure white or neutral gray parts.
entries.face: Eyes bright and wide, mouth open with anticipation; frame 4 has the widest eyes and most open mouth.
frames: BOWL CLOSE: bowl held at chest height, chopsticks resting on the rim, shoulders level.
CHOPSTICKS LIFT: one hand raises the chopsticks, elbow widening, head tilting.
LEAN IN: head moves toward the bowl, shoulders hunching, chopsticks opening.
PEAK — CHOPSTICKS WIDE OPEN, HEAD LOWEST, ELBOWS WIDEST: the widest and most compressed silhouette.
CHEWING: chopsticks lowering, cheeks rounding, shoulders easing.
BOWL CLOSE AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.

entries.name: 在吗？
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — NO PROPS AT ALL. No question mark, no speech bubble, no phone, no text.
entries.face: Eyes wide open and round, eyebrows raised, mouth a round O; frame 4 has the widest eyes and roundest O mouth.
entries.extra_guard: ONE HAND LOCK — Exactly ONE hand may be raised, and only to the SIDE of the mouth, held at the cheek/jaw with fingers spread and visible gaps. The round O mouth MUST stay FULLY VISIBLE in every frame; the palm NEVER covers the mouth or the lower half of the face. Both eyes always fully visible. FORBIDDEN: two hands over the mouth, a palm covering the face, wide-arm explosion, deep squat, exclamation marks, any AI-written text or symbol.
frames: PEEKING: head tilted slightly, one hand low near the cheek, eyes wide, mouth a small O.
HAND RISING: the single hand lifts to the side of the jaw, shoulder lifting a little.
LEAN SIDEWAYS: head tilting further, eyes widening, O mouth growing.
PEAK — WIDEST EYES, ROUNDEST O MOUTH, HAND AT CHEEK, DEEPEST HEAD TILT: the strongest state.
EASING BACK: head straightening a little, eyes softening, hand lowering slightly.
PEEKING AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
entries.recognition: 瞪眼张嘴、单手掩在嘴侧探头试探

entries.name: 我太难了
entries.prop_spec: PROP DETAIL — NO PROPS AT ALL. Do not add sweat drops, stars or text.
entries.face: Eyes squeezed shut, eyebrows folded inward, mouth a wide downturned grimace; frame 4 has the tightest eyes and widest grimace.
frames: TALL STANDING, SAGGING: upright but shoulders already low, arms hanging, head tipped down.
KNEES BUCKLING: knees bending, torso compressing, both arms dropping, head lower.
SIDE SLUMP: torso leaning far to one side, one hand on the knee, one shoulder much lower — clearly asymmetrical.
PEAK — DEEP SQUAT, HEAD IN BOTH HANDS, ELBOWS ON KNEES: the shortest and most compressed silhouette of all six frames.
SLOW RISE: knees straightening halfway, one hand leaving the head, shoulders still low.
TALL STANDING, SAGGING AGAIN: matching frame 1 so the loop closes.
